query.title: Search query
query.description: Free-text query, e.g. 'machine learning'. Combined with the other filters.

maxResults.title: Max results
maxResults.description: How many patents to return (1-1000; the Google Patents index caps search results at 1,000 per query).

cpc.title: CPC class
cpc.description: Optional CPC classification code, e.g. G06F or G06F17. Added to the query as cpc:<code>.

before.title: Filed before (YYYYMMDD)
before.description: Optional upper date bound on the priority date, e.g. 20230101.

after.title: Filed after (YYYYMMDD)
after.description: Optional lower date bound on the priority date, e.g. 20200101.

status.title: Status
status.description: Optional: limit to granted patents or published applications.

type.title: Kind
type.description: Optional: utility patents or design patents.

country.title: Country code
country.description: Optional two-letter country filter, e.g. US, EP, WO, CN.

language.title: Language
language.description: Optional language filter, e.g. ENGLISH, GERMAN.
